build_Minitaur: build a Minitaur quadruped robot instance by loading the minitaur URDF model into the PyBullet simulation
applyAction_Minitaur: apply motor commands to all eight motors of the Minitaur quadruped robot in the simulation
resetPose_Minitaur: reset the Minitaur quadruped robot to its default standing pose with all leg joints initialized
getMotorAngles_Minitaur: get the current joint angles of all eight motors on the Minitaur quadruped robot
getMotorVelocities_Minitaur: get the current angular velocities of all eight motors on the Minitaur quadruped robot
